import sys

def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(str_input):
        current = str_input[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(str_input) and str_input[j] == current:
            j += 1
        length = j - i
        if length % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
